provider.name: FAO ASFIS List of Species for Fishery Statistics Purposes
provider.organization_type: global aquatic species nomenclature, three-alpha coding, statistical classification, fishery, aquaculture, and production-reporting reference system
provider.description: The ASFIS List of Species for Fishery Statistics Purposes is maintained by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations. It provides standardized three-alpha codes, scientific names, FAO common names, taxonomic groupings, ISSCAAP classifications, and status information used in capture fisheries, aquaculture, commodities, and related statistical systems.
institutional_context: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
Coordinating Working Party on Fishery Statistics
National fisheries and aquaculture statistical authorities

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting ASFIS documentation, species codes, scientific and common names, ISSCAAP classifications, taxonomic groups, distributions, fishery statistics standards, downloads, manuals, APIs, licenses, citation guidance, and institutional context.
purpose.authoritative_notice: FAO, the ASFIS editorial authority, and official CWP statistical standards remain authoritative for species codes, classifications, list versions, statistical definitions, legal terms, and contacts.

review.notes: Primary FAO Fisheries and Aquaculture portal and discovery root.
